notable_features.text: Modern Hebrew is the sole surviving Canaanite language and a rare case of successful language revitalization, having been revived as a first language after centuries of primarily liturgical use. It follows an SVO word order, has a phoneme inventory of 30 sounds, and marks 7 distinct tense/aspect categories in its verbal system.
